notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
The update will be launched at 13 am PST/ 10 pm GMT+2!!!


Hello everyone,

we promised you the 2nd part of the content update, and we added some of the features into today's update, but we focused on fixes and improvements for better gameplay mostly, since it is quite essential to fix the known issues.
Anyway, we will update again another time this week, bringing the rest of the content of 0.2.
Check out today's changelog:


[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[list]
[*] add new sounds for player and wolf
[*] add german language support for menu
[*] add female deer actor
[*] add AI wolf "Deer Hunt" feature (added in the previous hotfix)
[*] add AI wolf "bloodthirst" (will only attack if hungry)
[*] player creates footprints on snow now 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400598/49d1082672ac99e660a91d6d4e56c842ff3f3d6b.png[/img]

[h1]Fixes & Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] improve AI killer attack
[*] fix AI wolf  & deer movement issues
[*] fix AI wolf  & deer sense range (fixed in the previous hotfix)
[*] improve campfire warmup time
[*] improve campfire crafting cooldown (60 seconds)
[*] fix display errors between menu and intro
[*] improve menu (save dropdown selection)
[*] fix the issue that you have to click in the viewport in the menu and in-game (added in the previous hotfix)
[*] improve shadows and light
[/list]

Cheers

Moonware Games

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:

[h1]Changelog [/h1]

notes.title: Content Update 0.2 will arrive the 15th of June
notes.content:
As mentioned in the latest hotfix notes, we are going to release some new content for you (two days later than planned) and step into the version 0.2. which will hold a new character, some more NPC interactions and of course some new and cruel killer decisions and features. We also will add for the first time a decision-based game feature, where you either decide to do as the killer say or you gonna pay for it (Some more will come in near feature).

Also, there are some changes within the map design, adding some more hiding possibilities and cleaning up some display errors within the graphics.

Another big thing we looked into is the performance. Since we could get about 5 to 10 FPS out of the latest update, we worked on some more improvements to get a better performance for lower pc specs.

We want to thank everyone for your support so far and we are looking forward to some new feedback.

Have a nice Sunday evening

Cheers

Moonware Games

notes.title: Content Update 0.1.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

before we start with today's changelog, we want to announce a huge content update for Sunday 10th of June at 2 PM PST. We got some smaller story elements, a new important NPC character and several decision-based gameplay prepared for this day.

Tomorrow we will launch another update, fixing some bugs of the latest hotfix and with some improvements on keybindings, UI and character handling (e.g. flashlight).

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] add new smaller huts all over the map
[*] spawn items inside huts only
[*] add new voices for the killer
[*] increase the hearing radius of the player
[*] add the intro sequence (please have some patience, the first 10 seconds of the video are black for a reason!)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400598/8d30c33df3ac0f47e5e72199d9f842b91c855933.png[/img]


Thanks for your support 

Cheers
Moonware Games

notes.title: Hotfix & Content Update 0.1.2
notes.content:
[h1] Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] fix some character movement issues 
[*] fix screen resolution bug ( gets now applied)
[*] fix menu bugs & add menu background video
[*] fix pick up item bug, which fixes also the campfire and medkit functions
[*] character cools down much slower (approx. 15 min)
[*] fix AI
[/list]

[h1] Changelog [/h1]

[list]
[*] animals and items spawn now randomly
[*] new killer functions added (roaming, chasing the player, hear and follow sounds)
[*] stumbling and tripping over roots and dead trees added
[*] branches spawn randomly on the ground and generate sound if step on them
[*] footprint sounds added

On Tuesday, 5th of June latest 5 PM PST we will release another content update. Since we want to add the content mostly bug-free we are working with small pieces day by day.

Cheers

Moonware Games

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.1
notes.content:
As we promised, we worked on the named issues and got everything working fine.

Here the short list of things we worked on.

- remove intro cinematic for complete overwork
- fix the sound bug in menu
- graphic settings are now functional

Please let us know if there are any performance issues so we can work on that as well (please provide your specs so that we can compare and find the best way of solving it)

Thanks for your support.

Cheers

Moonware Games

P.S.: We announce for this Sunday a content update.
